title: James E. Rogers Energy Complex
extract: James E. Rogers Energy Complex is an operating power station of at least 1530-megawatts (MW) in Cliffside, Cleveland, North Carolina, United States with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating. It is also known as Cliffside Plant.
